topic: Plan a summer vacation with your families

scenario.topic: Plan a summer vacation with your families
scenario.opening_question: What balance of relaxation, activities, and travel time works best for our families this summer?

options.name: Beach Resort in Outer Banks North Carolina
options.upside: Relaxed beach atmosphere with plenty of kid-friendly activities
options.tradeoff: Long drive may be tiring for younger children
options.concern: Limited nightlife and dining options for adults
options.best_for: families prioritizing outdoor beach time and budget control

options.name: All-Inclusive Family Resort in Cancun Mexico

attrs.activities_included: Pools, kids club, snorkeling, evening entertainment

options.upside: Convenient all-inclusive experience with many amenities on site
options.tradeoff: Less flexibility in dining and excursions outside the resort
options.concern: Passport and travel paperwork needed, plus potential language barriers
options.best_for: families wanting hassle-free planning and lots of on-site activities

options.name: Mountain Cabin Retreat in Smoky Mountains Tennessee
options.upside: Quiet nature setting with opportunities for outdoor adventure
options.tradeoff: Fewer structured activities for kids and limited dining options
options.concern: Potential for bugs and variable mountain weather
options.best_for: families valuing nature immersion and self-catered flexibility

options.name: City Cultural Tour in Washington D.C.

attrs.travel_time: 2 hours flight plus 30 minutes local transit
attrs.activities_included: Museums, monuments, guided tours, family-friendly shows

options.upside: Rich educational experiences and easy urban access
options.tradeoff: More expensive dining and less outdoor recreation
options.concern: Busy city environment might be overwhelming for young kids
options.best_for: families focused on culture, history, and short travel time

shared_context: We are three families planning a 7-day summer vacation together in July
The total budget is capped at $10,000 for all families combined
Our goal is to find a destination that suits both adults and kids, with manageable travel time

personas.name: Beatriz
personas.background: I enjoy quiet nature settings where my family can disconnect and enjoy outdoor adventures together.
personas.private_goal: I want a peaceful vacation spot with opportunities for hiking and wildlife watching that fits our budget.

personas.background: I appreciate cultural and educational experiences that are easy to access and enjoyable for the whole family.
personas.private_goal: I want a vacation with rich history and museums that also minimizes travel time for the kids.

turns.text:
Today we're deciding: Plan a summer vacation with your families.
For this simulated decision, I’ll treat the following setup as the shared facts.
Options:
A) Beach Resort in Outer Banks North Carolina — total cost: $9,200; travel time: 6 hours by car; accommodation type: Beachfront rental house (+ Relaxed beach atmosphere with plenty of kid-friendly activities; − Long drive may be tiring for younger children)
B) All-Inclusive Family Resort in Cancun Mexico — total cost: $9,800; travel time: 4.5 hours flight plus 1 hour transfer; accommodation type: All-inclusive resort rooms (+ Convenient all-inclusive experience with many amenities on site; − Less flexibility in dining and excursions outside the resort)
C) Mountain Cabin Retreat in Smoky Mountains Tennessee — total cost: $7,500; travel time: 5 hours by car; accommodation type: Private cabin with kitchen (+ Quiet nature setting with opportunities for outdoor adventure; − Fewer structured activities for kids and limited dining options)
D) City Cultural Tour in Washington D.C. — total cost: $8,700; travel time: 2 hours flight plus 30 minutes local transit; accommodation type: Downtown hotel suites (+ Rich educational experiences and easy urban access; − More expensive dining and less outdoor recreation)
Context: We are three families planning a 7-day summer vacation together in July; The total budget is capped at $10,000 for all families combined; Our goal is to find a destination that suits both adults and kids, with manageable travel time.
What balance of relaxation, activities, and travel time works best for our families this summer?
